title: flow_external_worker_job_unacquire input
description: Input for releasing the lock on an acquired external worker job. The job becomes acquirable again WITHOUT consuming one of its retries — the right report when the worker cannot do the work at all (no handler for the topic, or a shutdown while the job was held).

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
